name: NVIDIA Blackwell Architecture (official product page)
notes: NVIDIA Blackwell architecture product page. Key facts: 208B transistors, TSMC 4NP process, two reticle-limited dies connected by 10 TB/s chip-to-chip interconnect (NV-HBI). Second-gen Transformer Engine with microscaling formats (FP4). Blackwell Ultra: 2x attention-layer acceleration, 1.5x more AI compute FLOPS vs Blackwell. NVLink 5 scales to 576 GPUs. NVLink Switch Chip enables 130 TB/s in 72-GPU domain, 4x bandwidth efficiency with SHARP FP8 support. GB300 NVL72: 65x more AI compute than Hopper. Decompression engine (LZ4, Snappy, Deflate). RAS engine. TEE-I/O confidential computing.
